name: Hexarch Spindlethorn
description: Needle-thin mirrored sigils, all spike and hairline. They mean nothing, and he will happily explain them.

designs.title: Thorn Star
designs.description: An eight-pointed star of long needles and fine curves, sharp enough to read at any size.

designs.title: Spine Cross
designs.description: A long spiked cross with paired barbs running its whole length. Made for the backbone.

designs.title: Barbed Halo
designs.description: A twisted wire halo with spikes pointing both ways and a small star held at its centre.

designs.title: Bat Sigil
designs.description: A bat reduced to its bones: a few long tapering strokes and a thin line of membrane.

designs.title: Hexed Crown
designs.description: A crown of needles above a heavy band, with more of them raining down beneath it.
